run_qr_webserver: run the QR code webserver on a custom port with info text for Minecraft bot connection
generate_qrcode: generate a QR code image from info text and save it as qrcode.png in the current directory
update_qrcode: update an existing QR code image with new info without restarting the webserver
review_HTTPHandler: review the HTTPHandler class that serves HTML pages and PNG images via GET requests
refactor_makeQRCode: refactor the makeQRCode function to support custom output paths or image formats
